title: High-Frequency Tick Burst (500 ticks/sec) During Multi-Order Fan-Out
precondition: Central bank news release causes high tick rate.
steps: 1. Stream 500 ticks/sec while executing 10 block trades.
expected_result: Sizing engine processes allocations without queue backpressure; CPU utilization < 70%.
actual_result: Non-blocking event loop handles high tick rates without order queue backpressure; CPU utilization stays within safe thresholds.
